scope: Experimental Journalist synthesis: two fictional three-article worlds, three repetitions per model; no production publication
instruction: Synthesize fresh into one concise news report about meta, using voice as tone; preserve attribution, event dates and qualifications, and return only JSON with a report string.
source: Rust journalist_replay preparation; complete source excerpts checked against case inputs
timing_method: Wall time for each /api/chat request after an explicit model load; median of three repetitions per payload. Model load measured separately. Request order alternates the two payloads; later runs can benefit from prefix caching.
runtime_note: Initial default Ministral allocation offloaded 26/27 layers; temporary num_gpu=99 verified 27/27 and equal size/size_vram. All timed calls requested the same GPU setting; one model resident at a time.
